# pgconfig Provider

Manages PostgreSQL role/database configuration parameters (`ALTER ROLE ... SET` / `ALTER DATABASE ... SET`) as individual keys, so it can coexist with other providers that manage the same role/database.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pgconfig = {
      source = "winebarrel/pgconfig"
    }
  }
}

provider "pgconfig" {
  host     = "localhost"
  port     = 5432
  database = "postgres"
  username = "postgres"
  password = "postgres"
  sslmode  = "disable"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `aws_rds_iam_auth` (Boolean) Use RDS IAM auth instead of password authentication (see: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html).
- `aws_rds_iam_profile` (String) AWS profile to use for IAM auth.
- `aws_rds_iam_provider_role_arn` (String) AWS IAM role to assume for IAM auth.
- `aws_rds_iam_region` (String) AWS region to use for IAM auth.
- `clientcert` (Attributes) SSL client certificate, used for both providing the connection and authenticating. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clientcert))
- `conn_max_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Maximum amount of time, in seconds, a connection may be reused. Zero means unlimited. Defaults to `0`.
- `connect_timeout` (Number) Maximum wait, in seconds, for a connection to become available before returning an error. Defaults to `180`.
- `connection_retry_timeout_seconds` (Number) Total timeout, in seconds, for retrying a failed connection. Defaults to `5`.
- `database` (String) The database to connect to. Defaults to the `PGDATABASE` environment variable, or `postgres`.
- `host` (String) Name of PostgreSQL server address to connect to. Defaults to the `PGHOST` environment variable.
- `max_conn_retries` (Number) Maximum number of connection retries on failure. Defaults to `0`.
- `max_connections` (Number) Maximum number of connections to establish to the database. Zero means unlimited. Defaults to `20`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the PostgreSQL user. Defaults to the `PGPASSWORD` environment variable.
- `port` (Number) The PostgreSQL port number to connect to. Defaults to the `PGPORT` environment variable, or `5432`.
- `scheme` (String) The driver to use. One of `postgres`, `awspostgres` or `gcppostgres`. Defaults to `postgres`.
- `sslmode` (String) How to handle SSL connections. One of `disable`, `require`, `verify-ca` or `verify-full`. Defaults to the `PGSSLMODE` environment variable, or `require`.
- `sslrootcert` (String) The SSL server root certificate file path. The file must contain PEM encoded data.
- `username` (String) PostgreSQL user name to connect as. Defaults to the `PGUSER` environment variable.

<a id="nestedatt--clientcert"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clientcert`

Required:

- `cert` (String) The SSL client certificate file path. The file must contain PEM encoded data.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The SSL client certificate private key file path. The file must contain PEM encoded data.

Optional:

- `sslinline` (Boolean) Must be set to true if you are inlining the cert/key instead of using a file path.
